paragraphs: Every day, Tom gets up at six o'clock. He comes down the stairs to the kitchen and eats his rice and an egg. Then he combs his hair in front of the mirror. He takes his school bag from the hall. At seven o'clock, he travels to school by bus with Ben. They arrive at school at a quarter to eight.

Today the morning is different. The power is off, and Tom's clock does not ring. He wakes up at a quarter to seven, and his room is dark. "I am late!" he says. He puts on his uniform quickly. Then he runs down the stairs. There is no hot rice in the kitchen, so Dad gives him a banana. Tom combs his hair fast. He takes a bag from the hall and runs to the bus stop.

Ben waits at the bus stop. "Good morning," says Ben. "Your bag looks different today." Tom looks down and sees a pink bag with a flower. "Oh no, this is Lily's bag!" he says. Ben lifts the bag and laughs. "It is very light," he says. "Is there anything in it?" At school, Tom opens it. He finds a small book and a box of pencils.

Teacher Nick looks at Tom's desk. "Where are your books?" he asks. "I took the wrong bag," says Tom. "You can share a book with Ben today," says Teacher Nick. After school, Lily waits at the gate with a big blue bag. "I think we must swap," she says with a smile. "Your bag is very heavy!" They swap the bags. At home, the power is on again.
